ACTION: Read `references/fix-loop.md` and `references/file-handoffs.md` in the skill directory. The fix-loop file says to re-read it before every fix round, and the other file gives the BASE rule for the diff file.

ACTION: Read `docs/sync.md` around line 12. This checks the target before I edit it.

ACTION: Edit `docs/sync.md:12`. Change `--dry_run` to `--dry-run`. This touches only this file and only prose, and F1 says no code or test reads it.

ACTION: Commit the edit with a short message, for example `docs: fix --dry-run flag name in sync.md`.

ACTION: Append a note to the Task 3 implementer report file in `.sdd/14-buoy-sync/`. The note says I changed `docs/sync.md:12` from `--dry_run` to `--dry-run`, that the change does not alter behavior, and that no test covers it.

ACTION: Run `scripts/review-package specs/plans/14-buoy-sync.md <reviewed Task 3 head> <my fix commit>`. This writes the diff file for the re-review. I keep only the path it reports.

ACTION: Dispatch a scoped re-review on `sonnet` with `re-review-prompt.md`. The prompt names the diff file path, quotes F1 word for word, and asks for ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED on F1 plus any new Critical or Important finding. The prompt does not say what to ignore and does not rate F1.

ACTION: When the re-review reports F1 ADDRESSED with no new Critical or Important finding, append `Task 3: complete (commits <base7>..<head7>, review clean)` to the ledger. Then dispatch the Task 4 implementer.

Task 3 review found one Important issue. `docs/sync.md:12` wrote `--dry_run`, but the code uses `--dry-run`. I fixed that one word myself, because it is a docs-only change and nothing reads that file. A scoped re-review is now running, and I will start Task 4 when it passes.
